They Saw Rags. She Rewrote His Fate

They judge Mia by the clothes she wears. Edward Blake's life depends on what she knows. When the specialists fail the billionaire, a woman everyone overlooks becomes his last hope. Mia has concealed her extraordinary medical ability and the technology that sets her apart—but saving Edward means stepping into the light. As she challenges the verdict of the experts, the outcast they dismiss becomes the person whose judgment matters most. One intervention could save his life and expose the truth behind hers.
